# Bicycle-counts fixture

`counts.xlsx` is a small synthetic workbook generated by `make_fixture.py`; it is
not copied from or representative of actual counter measurements. It mirrors the
official workbook's sheet layout and header variants and includes the reviewed
legend fills, an empty header column, station aliases and directions, nearby
unverified coordinates, installation dates, spring and autumn DST cases,
overlapping year sheets (identical duplicates and one conflict), missing,
reconstructed and implausible cells, and a two-week window-coverage example.
It also includes one numeric theme-7-marked cell outside the spring DST gap; the
connector must discard it and flag both its daily and all-hours window records.

Regenerate it from `backend/` with:

```sh
uv run python tests/fixtures/bicycle_counts/make_fixture.py
```
